invariants.rationale: The method constructs a new HoodieWriteMetadata object and returns it; it cannot be null.
clusteringPlan is dereferenced in the implementation and must be non-null for correct operation.
schema is provided as a parameter and is typically required for processing write operations.
instantTime is used directly to pass into other method calls, must be non-null.
The WriteMetadata object has its write statuses explicitly set before the return.
